overview: Guidepoint is one of the largest expert networks globally, connecting more than 5,000 client organizations with 1.75 million+ advisors across 150+ industries and 500+ subsectors. The firm operates as a research enablement platform — providing not just expert access but also healthcare data intelligence (Qsight), content libraries (Guidepoint Insights with 65,000+ transcripts), live events (1,500+ per month), and since October 2025, the Guidepoint360 AI platform with its AskGP conversational research assistant. Guidepoint is privately held and founder-led by Albert Sebag, who serves as CEO. The company has grown from ~800 employees in 2020 to 1,700+ today across 19 global offices.

history.narrative: Guidepoint was founded in 2003 by Albert Sebag, an organic chemist turned patent attorney. Sebag earned his Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from Northeastern University (with research at MIT) and his J.D. from Boston College Law School. He began as a patent litigator at Kenyon & Kenyon advising generic pharma companies, then founded Clinical Advisors to match cancer patients with clinical trials. As the model expanded into broader healthcare and other industries, the company rebranded to Guidepoint Global in 2007. Through organic growth and three acquisitions — Vista Research (2009, from Standard & Poor's, giving Guidepoint Asia presence), Innosquared (2015, European expert network), and Quanton Data Analytics (2016, alternative data, foundation for Qsight) — Guidepoint has become one of the 'Big Five' expert networks.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: Guidepoint's core offering: one-on-one and multi-party consultations with advisors from its 1.75M+ network. Guidepoint assigns dedicated project managers to each engagement and emphasizes breadth of coverage across 150+ industries and 500+ subsectors. Calls include full compliance workflow with MNPI screening.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Scalable B2B surveys leveraging Guidepoint's advisor network for quantitative and qualitative market research. Surveys can be paired with follow-up calls and are used for market sizing, competitive benchmarking, customer sentiment, and pricing studies.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint Insights
servicesDetailed.description: A content library of more than 65,000 searchable transcripts and audio recordings from expert consultations. Guidepoint Insights provides reusable research content that clients can access without scheduling individual calls, complementing the bespoke call model.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint Qsight
servicesDetailed.description: A dedicated healthcare data intelligence platform providing alternative data products for healthcare and life sciences investors. Qsight offers sales intelligence, industry insights, and data analytics across pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech sectors — a significant differentiator from general-purpose competitors.

servicesDetailed.name: AI Moderation
servicesDetailed.description: An AI-powered capability that conducts expert interviews autonomously — without a live client present. AI runs structured interviews with consistent prompts and can run dozens simultaneously, 24/7. This produces 'AI-Guided' transcripts for the Insights library. Guidepoint claims 'thousands of interviews' facilitated for early-adopter clients. Note: AlphaSense launched a comparable AI Agent Interviewer product in August 2025, so Guidepoint is no longer the only major provider offering autonomous AI-conducted expert interviews.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint360 / AskGP
servicesDetailed.description: Launched in October 2025, Guidepoint360 is a unified platform merging AI and expert knowledge. AskGP is its conversational AI research assistant that synthesizes insights across Guidepoint's content library and expert interactions. A mobile app followed, delivering AI-driven research on the go.

servicesDetailed.name: Events
servicesDetailed.description: Guidepoint hosts 1,500+ live events per month including roundtables, teleconferences, and industry panels. Events bring together multiple advisors and clients around specific industry themes, providing broader perspective-gathering beyond one-on-one calls.

aiPlatform.narrative: Guidepoint's AI strategy has accelerated significantly in 2025. The centerpiece is Guidepoint360, launched in October 2025, which consolidates all client content — transcripts, call recordings, project briefs, and research — into a single AI-powered platform. AskGP, the conversational AI interface within Guidepoint360, lets clients query the full content library in natural language and synthesize insights across multiple expert interactions. Guidepoint also announced AI Moderation for enterprise-scale expert calls, and in early 2026 launched a Guidepoint360 mobile app for AI-driven research on the go.

complianceExtended.narrative: Guidepoint positions compliance as a core brand differentiator and structures its framework in three stages: Advisor Eligibility (third-party background checks, Employer Opt-Out Registry), Project Compliance (proprietary IT platform enforcing screens before workflow proceeds, advisor re-affirmation of T&Cs before each consultation), and Project Review (custom client controls, real-time dashboards). Advisors must complete a mandatory Compliance Tutorial upon joining and re-certify annually. Advisors are instructed to terminate any consultation where they believe they are being solicited for confidential or MNPI information — and are still paid for the full consultation. General Counsel Catherine Smith is a former Senior Counsel of the SEC Division of Enforcement.

complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: Guidepoint has never been charged with wrongdoing. However, its name appeared in several insider trading cases where individual consultants (Dr. Yves Benhamou, Winifred Jiau) were charged — in each case, the individuals deliberately circumvented Guidepoint's compliance controls rather than exploiting gaps in them. Massachusetts Secretary of State William Galvin also filed a complaint against Risk Reward Capital Management for using Guidepoint to obtain inside information, but Guidepoint itself was not charged. Per Integrity Research: 'Guidepoint's compliance procedures protected it from accusations of wrongdoing.' The SEC's 2022 Risk Alert on expert networks was industry-wide and not directed at Guidepoint specifically.

clientFit.narrative: Guidepoint serves the broadest client base among the Big Five expert networks, with 5,000+ organizations including institutional investors, consulting firms, corporates, legal teams, and government agencies. The firm's positioning emphasizes breadth, flexibility, and competitive pricing — making it accessible to teams with varying budgets and research intensity. Qsight provides a uniquely specialized offering for healthcare investors.
